note: YOUR constitution. identity=operated-self is a hard rule: distill the version of you that runs WITH your systems and compensation mechanisms, not raw instinct. Example rows below are generic starters — replace every one with principles anchored to your own logged cases (validator enforces).

principles.text: Leverage first question: anything recurring gets 'can this never need a human again?' before 'how do I do it?'
principles.applies: any process about to run a third time

principles.text: Read well, externalize the empathy: decisive low-empathy negotiators keep the reading skill and ship empathy as process — forced empathy pass on drafts, personal notes on file, LTV before any concession
principles.applies: outbound drafts, conflicts, long relationships (touches empathy weakness)
principles.compensation: review-step checklist: empathy pass + ≤3 personal notes per contact + LTV-before-concession

principles.text: Cadence over pressure: grade-based follow-up rhythm; waiting periods feed value, not reminders; one bump max, then a silence cycle
principles.compensation: cadence owned by the system, not the mood

rubrics.summary: two-source confirmation to commit; weak fit downgrades with a window; masks excluded
value × risk double track; stacked red flags = one veto
